{{Top|leg}}
'''Skimmers''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles specially constructed to participate in the [[Unification Gala]] on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]. Each skimmer was designed to represent a ship that was present at the [[Battle of Shindra's Veil]] and they were used to recreate the battle as part of the celebrations. Selected Gala attendees would be given a red ribbon upon entrance, and were the designated [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the forces representing [[Shey Tapani]] and his allies. The opposing skimmers represented the [[Rogue Houses]] and were controlled by [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]]. Each skimmer had a repulsorlift engine, miniature [[Laser/Legends|laser]] batteries and a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite.<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
